description: 5 should-trigger + 5 should-not-trigger. Should-trigger covers end-to-end image generation requests (brief → render). Should-not-trigger covers near-miss neighbors: routing-only questions (image-provider-routing), prompt-writing-only (prompt-engineering-image), image editing (image-editing), logo-specific flows (logo-generation), and rights checks (image-likeness-and-rights).
